ARABIC — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Public Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Public Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Public Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Public Speaking.

2. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Only memorise without using the language

3. When practising Attentive Listening: Translation and Transcription, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Translation and Transcription.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening: Translation and Transcription.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Study Skills: The Reading Process and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Extensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
